_comment: Which App Store subscriptions go to App Review with this version. ios/scripts/asc_review_package.py reads it: the strict readiness gate accepts READY_TO_SUBMIT only for submit_with_version products, and after a submission it checks that exactly those products entered review (and cancels the submission otherwise). A product the reviewer cannot find in the app is a rejection, so a product joins submit_with_version only when the app shows it to the review account.

submit_with_version.com.cmux.app.pro.monthly: cmux Pro, shown to every signed-in account on Settings > Account > Plan
submit_with_version.com.cmux.app.max.monthly: cmux Max, shown to every signed-in account on Settings > Account > Plan

not_in_this_version.com.cmux.app.go.monthly: cmux Go is release-gated by the goPlan flag (web/services/billing/goPlanFlag.ts); the review account is not in the rollout, so the reviewer cannot find it
not_in_this_version.com.cmux.app.pro.trial.monthly: the Pro trial is not offered by this app version (its client and server flow is not on main)

listing_must_not_name.cmux Go: the store description of every locale must not name a plan the reviewer cannot find (sync-listing fails on it)

promotional_images: subscription-images/<product id>.png, 1024x1024, uploaded when the product has none
